## Why (problem, and why this shape over the alternatives)

## Trade-off (what is given up; what would reverse this)

## Ponytail review (findings applied, or rejected with reason)

## Definition of done
- [ ] Why and trade-off sections filled in
- [ ] Ponytail review run on the diff
- [ ] Tests added or updated, `pytest` green locally
- [ ] Docs updated in the same PR (PRD / TRD / ADR / dev-log)
- [ ] `ruff check .` clean
- [ ] RSS budget still met (`scripts/measure_rss.py`) if models or deps changed
- [ ] Checked at the live URL after deploy
- [ ] No claim in UI or docs that is not deployed
